source.geography: ABS ASGS Edition 3 Local Government Areas 2025
source.note: Seeded from ABS LGA 2025 for Victoria, excluding unincorporated and statistical special-purpose codes (79 LGAs). Victoria uses Food Act 1984 class 1–4 registration or notification via FoodTrader.

unincorporated.label: PrimeSafe / Dairy Food Safety Victoria
unincorporated.regulator: PrimeSafe or Dairy Food Safety Victoria
unincorporated.notes: Meat and seafood processing sits with PrimeSafe; dairy with Dairy Food Safety Victoria. Fixed premises register with the council where the premises sits.

councils.name: Bayside Council
councils.notes: Register or notify via FoodTrader before operating a home-based food business.

councils.name: Boroondara Council
councils.notes: Food Act registration or notification via FoodTrader. Council assigns class 1–4. Home-based food businesses contact Environmental Health before operating.

councils.name: Darebin Council
councils.notes: Register or notify through FoodTrader. Council assigns Food Act class. Home-based food businesses contact Environmental Health before operating.

councils.name: Glen Eira Council
councils.notes: Register via FoodTrader. Home-based low-risk packaged foods may be class 3 or 4.

councils.name: Hobsons Bay Council
councils.notes: Food Act registration via FoodTrader portal. Home-based food businesses contact Environmental Health before operating.

councils.name: Kingston Council
councils.notes: Food Act registration via FoodTrader. Contact Environmental Health for class advice. Home-based food businesses contact Environmental Health before operating.

councils.name: Manningham Council
councils.notes: Food premises registration through FoodTrader. Home-based food businesses contact Environmental Health before operating.

councils.name: Maribyrnong Council
councils.notes: Register via FoodTrader. Home-based businesses contact Environmental Health before starting.

councils.name: Melbourne Council
councils.notes: All food premises must register under the Food Act 1984. Home-based businesses may need planning assessment under Clause 52.11 before operating.

councils.name: Merri-bek City Council
councils.notes: Register or notify via FoodTrader. Council classifies premises by Food Act class. Home-based food businesses contact Environmental Health before operating.

councils.name: Monash Council
councils.notes: Food premises registration through FoodTrader portal. Home-based food businesses contact Environmental Health before operating.

councils.name: Port Phillip Council
councils.notes: Food premises registration via FoodTrader. Contact Environmental Health before fit-out. Home-based food businesses contact Environmental Health before operating.

councils.name: Stonnington Council
councils.notes: Register food premises through FoodTrader. Home-based businesses contact Environmental Health early.

councils.name: Whitehorse Council
councils.notes: Register food premises on FoodTrader. Home kitchen class determined by EHO.

councils.name: Yarra Council
councils.notes: Food premises registration on FoodTrader. Contact council for home-based class advice.
